transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to know, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful to know. I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust. If it’s mild, sunglasses outside can help.

But significant pain in bright light, or strong light sensitivity with a red and painful eye, is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle over time.

If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that answers all of my questions. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass
